analysis: The implementation appears valid because feature dimension changed and all prediction hashes differ, so the rollback reflects a substantive model result rather than a no-op. The hypothesis is not supported on the fixed official validation protocol: the candidate's ensemble primary was 0.6041756 versus the search parent at 0.6049134, a delta of -0.0007378, with paired 95% CI [-0.0014162, -0.0000372] excluding zero. It also failed to improve the active portfolio: delta -0.0002527, with CI crossing zero, so there is no promotion evidence. Seed-level comparison was less decisive, but its mean direction was still negative. Diagnostic slices suggest heterogeneous effects—positive for the lowest-history users and more popular items, but negative for most history strata and every tab slice—so they motivate future targeted hypotheses but do not override the official aggregate result or justify selective deployment from this experiment alone. The prior curated evidence therefore did not transfer to this parent/configuration and split.
next_lesson: Do not add all seven profile fields globally; test one predeclared targeted profile-interaction mechanism motivated by the observed low-history-user heterogeneity.
